technologies.name: Primitive Workbench
technologies.description: Primitive Workbench for producing simple items. Pals with Handiwork suitability help speed up production.

technologies.name: Stone Axe
technologies.description: An axe for cutting wood. Made from stone, it's not very sharp.

technologies.name: Stone Pickaxe
technologies.description: A pickaxe used for mining. Made from stone, the efficiency is questionable.

technologies.name: Hand-Held Torch
technologies.description: Lights up dark areas and keeps you warm. Can also be used for close-range combat in a pinch. Can be crafted at Primitive Workbench.

technologies.name: Wooden Club
technologies.description: A Wooden Club for close range combat. Can beat a small Pal to a pulp if need be.

technologies.name: Palbox
technologies.description: Facility for storing captured Pals. Pals inside gradually recover Health. The area around this structure will become your base.

technologies.name: Pal Sphere
technologies.description: An item that captures Pals when thrown. This basic model is only effective on low level Pals.

technologies.name: Campfire
technologies.description: Used to make simple food or provide meager warmth and light.

technologies.name: Wooden Chest
technologies.description: Used to store items. Place at a base and Pals with Transporting suitability will automatically carry items to it.

technologies.name: Repair Bench
technologies.description: Repairs damaged weapons and tools.

technologies.name: Wooden Structure Set
technologies.description: Set for building bases using wood. Allows building of wooden foundations, walls, ceilings, stairs and other things necessary for shelters.

technologies.name: Pal Dressing Facility
technologies.description: Pal Dressing Facility. Give your Pals a new look! Skins obtained inside and outside the game can be applied here!

technologies.name: Old Bow
technologies.description: Primitive long-range weapon. Hastily put together, it isn't very powerful. Can be crafted at Primitive Workbench.

technologies.name: Arrow
technologies.description: Arrows for use with bows. Can be crafted at Primitive Workbench.

technologies.name: Stone Spear
technologies.description: Useful for close-range combat. Its length allows you to stand further away when attacking.

technologies.name: Shoddy Bed
technologies.description: Human bed. Sleeping restores Health. Sleep at night and time will pass until morning. Cannot sleep unless built under a roof.

technologies.name: Straw Pal Bed
technologies.description: Pals at base recover SAN when sleeping in beds at night. Without a Pal Bed, Pals cannot sleep soundly, and no SAN is recovered.

technologies.name: Global Palbox
technologies.description: A facility that can store the genetic data of Pals and allows you to reconstruct them from this data. The stored genetic data can also be transferred to other worlds.

technologies.name: Common Shield
technologies.description: Strange shield made with Paldium technology. It automatically repair itself after not taking damage for a while.

technologies.name: Cloth Outfit
technologies.description: Clothes made from Cloth. Protects against cold nights. Can be crafted at Primitive Workbench.

technologies.name: Cloth
technologies.description: Cloth woven from Wool. Required to create armor. Can be crafted at Primitive Workbench.

technologies.name: Feed Box
technologies.description: Place food here, and Pals at the base will eat from it.

technologies.name: Berry Plantation
technologies.description: Can produce berries at a base. Requires Pal with Planting, Watering, and Gathering suitabilities.

technologies.name: Ranch
technologies.description: Ranch for raising sheep and fowl-like Pals. Assign Pals with the appropriate work suitability to the ranch to automatically produce items.

technologies.name: Normal Parachute
technologies.description: A glider for soaring through the air. Cheaply made, it isn't very fast.

technologies.name: Pal Gear Workbench
technologies.description: Produces items that allow Pals to use Partner Skills.

technologies.name: Fire Arrow
technologies.description: Fire Arrows for use with bows. Deals Fire damage on contact. Can be crafted at Primitive Workbench.

technologies.name: Mounted Torch
technologies.description: Place it at a base to light the surrounding area.

technologies.name: Sign
technologies.description: Can be written on.

technologies.name: Wall-Mounted Sign
technologies.description: A signboard to write on. Can be hung on walls.

technologies.name: Rushoar Saddle
technologies.description: Saddle for safely riding Rushoar.

technologies.name: Foxparks' Harness
technologies.description: Harness for holding Foxparks. Activate its Partner Skill to hold Foxparks and attack using it as a flamethrower.

technologies.name: Monitoring Stand
technologies.description: Command your Pals to work on various things inside a base. You can allow or prohibit individual kinds of work.

technologies.name: Bat
technologies.description: Baseball bat for close-range combat. Might be tough to get a home run with a Pal.

technologies.name: Logging Site
technologies.description: Can produce wood at a base. Requires Pal with Lumbering suitability.

technologies.name: Stone Pit
technologies.description: Can produce stone at a base. Requires Pal with Mining suitability.

technologies.name: Sandbag
technologies.description: Pals assigned to it will watch for approaching enemies.

technologies.name: Alarm Bell
technologies.description: Bell that sets the alert status for Pals on base. Change Pal behavior to either attack invading enemies or focus entirely on work whenever you like.

technologies.name: Melpaca Saddle
technologies.description: Saddle for safely riding Melpaca.

technologies.name: Crusher
technologies.description: Facility for breaking down Stone and Wood to exchange them for other materials. Requires Pal with the Watering suitability to spin the water turbine.

technologies.name: Poison Arrow
technologies.description: Poison Arrows for use with bows. Afflicts target with Poison on contact. Can be crafted at Primitive Workbench.

technologies.name: Wooden Defensive Wall
technologies.description: Massive defensive wall to prevent enemy intrusions. Made from wood, it breaks easily.

technologies.name: Wooden Gate
technologies.description: Wooden gate large enough for big Pals to pass through.

technologies.name: Hanging Trap
technologies.description: Catches Pals that pass through. Only effective on small Pals and humans.

technologies.name: Statue of Power
technologies.description: Make offerings to enhance the stats of the Player and their Pals.

technologies.name: Small Feed Bag
technologies.description: A small pouch for holding food. Unlocks a food slot in your inventory. Players and Pals automatically consume food when hungry. Carrying one is enough.

technologies.name: Tropical Outfit
technologies.description: A Cloth Outfit produced in hot regions. Boasts high heat resistance. Can be crafted at Primitive Workbench.

technologies.name: Tundra Outfit
technologies.description: A Cloth Outfit produced in cold regions. Useful for surviving in cold climates. Can be crafted at Primitive Workbench.

technologies.name: Hot Spring
technologies.description: Pals recover SAN while in a Hot Spring.

technologies.name: Direhowl's Saddled Harness
technologies.description: Saddle for safely riding Direhowl.

technologies.name: Primitive Furnace
technologies.description: Uses Ore to produce Ingots.

technologies.name: Three Shot Bow
technologies.description: An enhanced bow that allows three arrows to be fired simultaneously. By some strange mechanism, it only consumes a single Arrow when fired.

technologies.name: Feathered Hair Band
technologies.description: A beautiful feathered headband. Though improbable, it somehow seems to protect its wearer from lethal head injuries. Can be crafted at Primitive Workbench.

technologies.name: Nail
technologies.description: Necessary for building various facilities. Can be crafted at Primitive Workbench.

technologies.name: Ladder
technologies.description: A ladder that allows you to climb to a slightly higher place.

technologies.name: Bear Trap (Small)
technologies.description: Immobilizes those who step on it. Only effective on small Pals or humans.

technologies.name: Egg Incubator
technologies.description: Place a Pal Egg inside to incubate it.

technologies.name: Metal Axe
technologies.description: A metal axe capable of cutting down even hard trees. Effective against the sturdy trees that grow deep within the continent. Can be crafted at High-Quality Workbench.

technologies.name: Metal Pickaxe
technologies.description: A pickaxe used for mining. Made from metal, its durability and efficiency have improved. Can be crafted at High-Quality Workbench.

technologies.name: High-Quality Workbench
technologies.description: Produces faster than Primitive Workbench. Requires Pal with Handiwork trait.

technologies.name: Rayne Syndicate Flag Set
technologies.description: Rayne Syndicate Standard and Rayne Syndicate Vertical Banner set. Proof of your victory over the Rayne Syndicate.

technologies.name: Chillet Saddle
technologies.description: Saddle for safely riding Chillet.

technologies.name: Lifmunk's Submachine Gun
technologies.description: Submachine gun made specifically for Lifmunk. Activate its Partner Skill, and Lifmunk will ride on your head and fire at enemies.

technologies.name: Pelt Armor
technologies.description: Armor made from Leather. Its warmth and defense have been improved. Can be crafted at High-Quality Workbench.

technologies.name: Meat Cleaver
technologies.description: Knife for butchering Pals. When equipped, the Pet command becomes Butcher. Butchered Pals will be gone for good.

technologies.name: Medieval Medicine Workbench
technologies.description: Can produce simple medicine. Requires Pal with Medicine Production trait.

technologies.name: Tanzee's Assault Rifle
technologies.description: Assault rifle made specifically for Tanzee. Activate its Partner Skill, and Tanzee will enter gunner mode and begin shooting at nearby enemies.

technologies.name: Eikthyrdeer Saddle
technologies.description: Saddle for safely riding Eikthyrdeer.

technologies.name: Grappling Gun
technologies.description: It fires a hook that latches on to distant targets, pulling the user's body towards the target. It allows for easy movement between places with varying elevation.

technologies.name: Crossbow
technologies.description: Fires an Arrow effortlessly. Though it takes time to load, it delivers a powerful shot. Can be crafted at High-Quality Workbench.

technologies.name: Metal Spear
technologies.description: Useful for close-range combat. The metal tip gives it increased attack power. Can be crafted at High-Quality Workbench.

technologies.name: Metal Chest
technologies.description: Can be used to store more items. Pals with Transporting suitability will automatically carry items to it.

technologies.name: Cooler Box
technologies.description: Small food vault. Assign an Ice Pal to help prevent food stored inside from spoiling.

technologies.name: Training Dummy
technologies.description: Training dummy shaped like a Pengullet.

technologies.name: Tanzee Ignis's Assault Rifle
technologies.description: Assault rifle made specifically for Tanzee Ignis. Activate its Partner Skill, and Tanzee Ignis will enter gunner mode and begin shooting at nearby enemies.

technologies.name: Mega Sphere
technologies.description: An item that captures Pals when thrown. Its capabilities have been improved, allowing it to catch a wider range of Pals. Can be crafted at Sphere Workbench.

technologies.name: Sphere Workbench
technologies.description: Produces Spheres for capturing Pals. Requires Pal with Handiwork suitability.

technologies.name: Average Feed Bag
technologies.description: A decently sized pouch for holding food. Unlocks 2 food slots in your inventory. Players and Pals automatically consume food when hungry. Carrying one is enough.

technologies.name: Wall Torch
technologies.description: Place it on a wall to light the surrounding area.

technologies.name: Univolt Saddle
technologies.description: Saddle for safely riding Univolt.

technologies.name: Pal Essence Condenser
technologies.description: Combines several Pals of the same type to create a higher-ranked version.

technologies.name: Beginner Fishing Set
technologies.description: Beginner-friendly fishing rod and bait set. Once you craft both, you'll be able to fish for Pals near bodies of water.

technologies.name: Wheat Plantation
technologies.description: Use it to grow ingredients for Bread. Requires Pal with Planting, Watering, and Gathering suitabilities.

technologies.name: Mill
technologies.description: Facility for milling Wheat to produce Flour. Requires Pal with the Watering suitability to spin the water turbine.

technologies.name: Wooden Board
technologies.description: Planks made from processed wood for easier use. More versatile than raw logs, with a wide variety of uses. Can be crafted at Primitive Workbench.

technologies.name: Viewing Cage
technologies.description: Container for observing captured Pals. Pals inside cannot participate in battle or production, but they do not become hungry.

technologies.name: Arsox Saddle
technologies.description: Saddle for safely riding Arsox.

technologies.name: Nitewing Saddle
technologies.description: Saddle for safely riding Nitewing.

technologies.name: Hip Lantern
technologies.description: A lantern that can be attached to the hip. It lights up automatically at night. You can also switch its lighting mode to keep it on at all times. Just one is enough to find your way in the dark.

technologies.name: Mega Shield
technologies.description: Strange shield made with Paldium technology. The new model has been improved, enhancing its defense. Can be made at High-Quality Workbench.

technologies.name: Heat Resistant Pelt Armor
technologies.description: A Pelt Armor produced in hot regions. Boasts high heat resistance. Can be crafted at High-Quality Workbench.

technologies.name: Surfent Saddle
technologies.description: Saddle for safely riding Surfent.

technologies.name: Lockpicking Tool v1
technologies.description: No key? No problem! These tools will allow you to try and pry open any treasure chest that would normally require a Copper Key.

technologies.name: Primitive Sword
technologies.description: A sword for close-range combat. Not bad for a battered sword. Perfect for getting up close and personal.

technologies.name: Cooking Pot
technologies.description: Can efficiently prepare more varieties of foods.

technologies.name: Heater
technologies.description: Warms the nearby area and protects against the cold.

technologies.name: Tombstone
technologies.description: A gravestone that can be inscribed with text. Use it for recording purposes.

technologies.name: Pengullet Rocket Launcher
technologies.description: Rocket launcher for launching Pengullet. Activate its Partner Skill to fire Pengullet and damage enemies. After firing, Pengullet will become incapacitated.

technologies.name: Mega Grappling Gun
technologies.description: It fires a hook that latches on to distant targets, pulling the user's body towards the target. Since it's upgraded, it now has greater range.

technologies.name: Mega Glider
technologies.description: A glider for soaring through the air. A mass produced commercial model, it’s decently fast. Can be made at High-Quality Workbench.

technologies.name: Cold Resistant Pelt Armor
technologies.description: A Pelt Armor produced in cold regions. Useful for surviving in cold climates. Can be crafted at High-Quality Workbench.

technologies.name: Cooler
technologies.description: Cools the nearby area and protects against the heat.

technologies.name: Tocotoco's Gloves
technologies.description: Gloves for gently holding Tocotoco. Activate its Partner Skill to hold Tocotoco and use it to fire explosive eggs.

technologies.name: Pengullet Lux's Rocket Launcher
technologies.description: Rocket launcher for launching Pengullet Lux. Activate its Partner Skill to fire Pengullet Lux and damage enemies. After firing, Pengullet Lux will become incapacitated.

technologies.name: Ring of Mercy
technologies.description: Pacifist's ring. The wearer's attacks will not reduce the target's Health below 1.

technologies.name: Breeding Farm
technologies.description: Assign a male and a female Pal to produce eggs. Cake is required for breeding.

technologies.name: Pal Labor Research Lab
technologies.description: A facility for conducting research on the various tasks of Pals. By assigning tasks to Pals in this facility, research progresses, granting various benefits.

technologies.name: Heavy Weight Module
technologies.description: Equipping it makes the sphere heavier, reducing its range but increasing its capture power.

technologies.name: Cement
technologies.description: Cement used for creating structures and more. Can be produced in a High-Quality Workbench.

technologies.name: Stone Structure Set
technologies.description: Set for building bases using stone. Allows building of stone foundations, walls, ceilings, stairs and other things necessary for shelters.

technologies.name: Stone Defensive Wall
technologies.description: Large defensive wall that protects from enemy invasions.

technologies.name: Stone Gate
technologies.description: Stone gate large enough for big Pals to pass through.

technologies.name: Grintale Saddle
technologies.description: Saddle for safely riding Grintale.

technologies.name: Giga Sphere
technologies.description: An item that captures Pals when thrown. Able to capture moderately powerful Pals. Can be crafted at Sphere Workbench.

technologies.name: Weapon Workbench
technologies.description: Produces simple mechanical weapons. Requires Pal with Handiwork suitability.

technologies.name: Large Toolbox
technologies.description: Place in base to improve handiwork speed. Placing more than one has no additional effect.

technologies.name: Free Pal Alliance Flag Set
technologies.description: Free Pal Alliance Standard and Free Pal Alliance Vertical Banner set. Proof of your victory over the Free Pal Alliance.

technologies.name: Elphidran Saddle
technologies.description: Saddle for safely riding Elphidran.

technologies.name: Tarantriss Saddle
technologies.description: Saddle for safely riding Tarantriss.

technologies.name: Sweepa Saddle
technologies.description: Saddle for safely riding Sweepa.

technologies.name: Dimensional Pal Storage
technologies.description: A facility for storing a large number of captured Pals. Any guild member can deposit or withdraw Pals. If you set it to private, it can serve as your personal Pal storage.

technologies.name: Musket
technologies.description: Simple, old-fashioned gun. Fires a single, powerful shot at the expense of a long reload time. Can be crafted at Weapon Workbench.

technologies.name: Gunpowder
technologies.description: Gunpowder used to fire ammunition. Required to make bullets. Can be made at High-Quality Workbench.

technologies.name: Coarse Ammo
technologies.description: Ammo for the Musket, Makeshift Handgun, and similar weapons. Can be crafted at Weapon Workbench.

technologies.name: Tomato Plantation
technologies.description: Farm for producing tomatoes. Requires Pal with Planting, Watering, and Gathering suitabilities.

technologies.name: Flame Cauldron
technologies.description: Place in base to improve fire-making speed. Placing more than one has no additional effect.

technologies.name: Bear Trap (Large)
technologies.description: Immobilizes those who step on it. Only effective on large Pals.

technologies.name: Vanwyrm Saddle
technologies.description: Saddle for safely riding Vanwyrm.

technologies.name: Eikthyrdeer Terra Saddle
technologies.description: Saddle for safely riding Eikthyrdeer Terra.

technologies.name: Antique Dresser
technologies.description: Dresser useful for giving yourself a remake. Allows players to edit their appearance.

technologies.name: Pal Expedition Station
technologies.description: A facility that allows Pals to be sent on expeditions to places like dungeons. The dispatched Pals engage in battles and gather items, bringing back resources to the base.

technologies.name: Stun Baton
technologies.description: Close range weapon that sends out an electric jolt upon contact. Pals are easier to capture when electrocuted. Can be crafted at High-Quality Workbench.

technologies.name: High Quality Bait
technologies.description: Bait that lures in Pals. Improved so that Pals bite the bait more easily, and the amount of items obtained from fishing now increases ever so slightly.

technologies.name: Flea Market (Items)
technologies.description: A facility for selling items. By setting products in the sales list, you can sell items to other players. Assign an Ice Pal to it and the food inside will be less likely to spoil.

technologies.name: Flea Market (Pals)
technologies.description: A facility for selling Pals. By setting Pals in the sales list, you can sell them to other players. Assign an Ice Pal to it and the food inside will be less likely to spoil.

technologies.name: Vanwyrm Cryst Saddle
technologies.description: Saddle for safely riding Vanwyrm Cryst.

technologies.name: Homeward Thundercloud
technologies.description: Transports you to the nearest base. Cannot be used in dungeons and other similar locations.

technologies.name: Metal Armor
technologies.description: Armor made of metal. Somewhat heavy, but provides good defense. Can be crafted at High-Quality Workbench.

technologies.name: Metal Helm
technologies.description: A helm made of metal. A reliable piece of armor that protects your head, and all the thoughts within. Can be crafted at High-Quality Workbench.

technologies.name: Curve Module
technologies.description: Equipping it causes the sphere to spin with a curved trajectory. It becomes easier to catch Pals off guard, and increases capture power.

technologies.name: Large Feed Bag
technologies.description: A large pouch for holding food. Unlocks 3 food slots in your inventory. Players and Pals automatically consume food when hungry. Carrying one is enough.

technologies.name: Water Fountain
technologies.description: Place in base to improve watering speed. Placing more than one has no additional effect.

technologies.name: Kingpaca Saddle
technologies.description: Saddle for safely riding Kingpaca.

technologies.name: Aquatic Construction Kit
technologies.description: Construction kit that allows foundations to be placed on water.

technologies.name: Makeshift Handgun
technologies.description: A handgun created from spare parts. Relatively well suited for close quarters combat, but can only fire one shot before needing to reload. Crafted at Weapon Workbench.

technologies.name: Fluffy Pal Bed
technologies.description: Pals sleep more soundly, improving the amount of Health and SAN recovered while sleeping.

technologies.name: Medicine Rack
technologies.description: A shelf for storing medicine. Sick Pals will come here to take their medicine. Be sure to keep the medicine stocked.

technologies.name: Clinic
technologies.description: A basic medical facility for managing the health of Pals working at the base. Assigning a Pal with Medicine Production suitability helps reduce SAN depletion and prevent illness and injury. While sanitation has its limits, it plays a crucial role in early base development.

technologies.name: Flower Bed
technologies.description: Place in base to improve gathering speed. Placing more than one has no additional effect.

technologies.name: Foxparks Cryst's Harness
technologies.description: Harness for holding Foxparks Cryst. Activate its Partner Skill to hold Foxparks Cryst and release freezing air to attack.

technologies.name: Azurobe Saddle
technologies.description: Saddle for safely riding Azurobe.

technologies.name: Dinossom Saddle
technologies.description: Saddle for safely riding Dinossom.

technologies.name: Ore Mining Site
technologies.description: Facility for producing Ore. Mining Ore is hard work that requires physical endurance. Leave it to Pals skilled at mining.

technologies.name: Boost Gun
technologies.description: Firing this at a Pal in your team temporarily boosts that Pal's attack and defense. Firing it at an enemy deals damage instead.

technologies.name: Boost Gun Ammo
technologies.description: Ammo for the Boost Gun and similar weapons. Can be crafted at Weapon Workbench.

technologies.name: Heat Resistant Metal Armor
technologies.description: Improved Metal Armor. Boasts high heat resistance. Can be crafted at High-Quality Workbench.

technologies.name: Lettuce Plantation
technologies.description: Farm for producing lettuce. Requires Pal with Planting, Watering, and Gathering suitabilities.

technologies.name: Silo
technologies.description: Place in base to improve planting speed. Placing more than one has no additional effect.

technologies.name: Frag Grenade
technologies.description: A Frag Grenade useful for mid-range combat. It detonates a few seconds after being thrown, dealing damage to enemies.

technologies.name: Surfent Terra Saddle
technologies.description: Saddle for safely riding Surfent Terra.

technologies.name: Helzephyr Saddle
technologies.description: Saddle for safely riding Helzephyr.

technologies.name: Lockpicking Tool v2
technologies.description: No key? No problem! These tools will allow you to try and pry open any treasure chest that would normally require a Silver Key.

technologies.name: Makeshift SMG
technologies.description: A submachine gun handmade from scraps. It excels in rate of fire, but its single-shot power is low.

technologies.name: Power Generator
technologies.description: Electric Pals at the base can now store electricity, allowing the use of electric facilities.

technologies.name: Lamp
technologies.description: Lights up dark areas at a base.

technologies.name: Human-Powered Generator
technologies.description: A facility that converts rotational motion into electrical energy. The efficiency is low, and the Pals working here will experience a decrease in SAN value, but they will gain experience points.

technologies.name: Mounted Crossbow
technologies.description: Assign a Pal with Handiwork suitability and it will protect a base using the crossbow.

technologies.name: Fenglope Saddle
technologies.description: Saddle for safely riding Fenglope.

technologies.name: Polapup Saddle
technologies.description: Saddle for safely riding Polapup.

technologies.name: Single-Shot Sphere Launcher
technologies.description: A launcher that fires spheres. It can capture Pals from a greater distance. Can be crafted at Weapon Workbench.

technologies.name: Hyper Sphere
technologies.description: An item that captures Pals when thrown. Enhanced capabilities allow it to capture even more powerful Pals. Can be crafted at Sphere Assembly Line.

technologies.name: Sphere Assembly Line
technologies.description: Creates Pal Spheres at a faster pace. Requires Pal with Handiwork suitability.

technologies.name: Cold Resistant Metal Armor
technologies.description: Improved Metal Armor. Useful for surviving in cold climates. Can be crafted at High-Quality Workbench.

technologies.name: Small Pouch
technologies.description: A small pouch that allows you to carry additional items. Holding it increases your inventory slots. Carrying one is enough.

technologies.name: Ceiling Lamp
technologies.description: Lights up dark areas below at a base.

technologies.name: Shock Grenade
technologies.description: A Shock Grenade useful for mid-range combat. It detonates a few seconds after being thrown, electrocuting everything in the blast radius.

technologies.name: Extra Weapon Holster
technologies.description: A holster that allows an additional weapon to be equipped. While in possession, it increases weapon equip slots by 1. Carrying one is enough.

technologies.name: Azurobe Cryst Saddle
technologies.description: Saddle for safely riding Azurobe Cryst.

technologies.name: Handgun
technologies.description: A handgun with improved capacity and rapid-fire capabilities. Has more immediate firepower than a Makeshift Handgun. Crafted at Weapon Workbench.

technologies.name: Handgun Ammo
technologies.description: Ammo for the Handgun and similar weapons. Can be crafted at Weapon Workbench.

technologies.name: Fine Bed
technologies.description: Soft bed with improved restorative capabilities. Cannot sleep unless built under a roof.

technologies.name: High Quality Monitoring Stand
technologies.description: A refined monitoring station with improved materials and structure. In addition to being able to issue work orders, the system also lowers the SAN cost for Pals working at the base. Working conditions are slightly improved, making Pals less likely to become dissatisfied.

technologies.name: Stump and Axe
technologies.description: Place in base to improve logging speed. Placing more than one has no additional effect.

technologies.name: Brothers of the Eternal Pyre Flag Set
technologies.description: Brothers of the Eternal Pyre Standard and Brothers of the Eternal Pyre Vertical Banner set. Proof of your victory over the Brothers of the Eternal Pyre.

unlocks.name: Brothers of the Eternal Pyre Standard
Brothers of the Eternal Pyre Vertical Banner

technologies.name: Dazemu Saddle
technologies.description: Saddle for safely riding Dazemu.

technologies.name: Mammorest Saddle
technologies.description: Saddle for safely riding Mammorest.

technologies.name: Anti-Gravity Belt
technologies.description: An accessory that increases the player's jump power when equipped.

technologies.name: Giga Shield
technologies.description: Strange shield made with Paldium technology. Modifications have enhanced its effectiveness even further. Can be made at Production Assembly Line.

technologies.name: Sword
technologies.description: Sword for close-range combat. The blade is extremely sharp! Mightier than a pen, for sure. Can be crafted at Weapon Workbench.

technologies.name: Intermediate Fishing Rod (Cattiva)
technologies.description: A fishing rod designed for catching Pals. Use it with bait near water where shadows are visible to start fishing. It boasts improved performance, making catches a bit easier.

technologies.name: Production Assembly Line
technologies.description: Needs electricity but produces items at a faster pace. Requires Pal with Handiwork trait.

technologies.name: Potato Plantation
technologies.description: A farm where you can grow Potato. It takes time to harvest, but increases the variety of meals you can prepare. Requires a few Pals to plant seeds, water, and harvest the crops.

technologies.name: Ice Grenade
technologies.description: A Ice Grenade useful for mid-range combat. It detonates a few seconds after being thrown, freezing the surrounding area.

technologies.name: Pyrin Saddle
technologies.description: Saddle for safely riding Pyrin.

technologies.name: Beakon Saddle
technologies.description: Saddle for safely riding Beakon.

technologies.name: Enhanced Hip Lantern
technologies.description: A lantern that can be attached to the hip. It lights up automatically at night. You can also switch its lighting mode to keep it on at all times. Just one is enough to find your way in the dark.

technologies.name: Makeshift Shotgun
technologies.description: A shotgun handmade from scraps. It has a short range but excels in close-range combat

technologies.name: Mine
technologies.description: Automatically detonates when stepped on.

technologies.name: Metal Structure Set
technologies.description: Set for building bases using metal. Allows building of metal foundations, walls, ceilings, stairs and other things necessary for shelters.

technologies.name: Metal Defensive Wall
technologies.description: Massive defensive wall to prevent enemy intrusions. Made from metal, it is extremely durable.

technologies.name: Iron Gate
technologies.description: Metal gate large enough for big Pals to pass through.

technologies.name: Mining Cart
technologies.description: Place in base to improve mining speed. Placing more than one has no additional effect.

technologies.name: Mushroom Cake
technologies.description: Place it in the chest at a Breeding Farm to make Pals lay a particularly healthy egg. The talents of the resulting Pals will grow slightly more easily.

technologies.name: Rayhound Saddle
